author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಆತತಾಯಿಗಳಂತೆ ನರಕವನೆ ತೋರದಿರು
ಸೋತೊಡೆದ ಮನಗಳಲಿ ಚೈತನ್ಯ ತುಂಬು
ಶ್ವೇತಕಾಕೀಯದಂತಿರಲು ಜನ ನೆರೆಹೊರೆಯು
ಸೇತುವದೆ ಬೆಸೆವುದಕೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Do not show people hell, like those who do violence;
fill with life the minds that are defeated and broken;
when neighbours are like a white crow, a rare thing,
you are the bridge that joins them, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Don’t make life hell for others. Revive broken spirits. Good neighbours are rare; be the bridge that brings people together.
